# TEST_RESULTS.md - Consolidated Test Register

*Generated by `scripts/gen_phase2_reports.py` (and `scripts/gen_test_register.py` for Phase 1) from the saved logs in `results/` and `build/`. Do not edit by hand.*

Environment: Icarus Verilog version 13.0 (stable) (v13_0); Yosys 0.71+p; Python 3.14.5

## Phase 2 - summary

| Item | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Directed + edge-case tests (D-00..D-30, E-01..E-11, L-01, C-01) at L=4 with exhaustive 64 KiB sweep | 47 of 47 tests PASS | `results/complete_test_results.txt` |
| Same tests at 22 fixed memory latencies (L = 0..16, 32, 64, 100, 255, 1000) | all PASS at every latency | `results/phase2_latency_sweep.txt` |
| Same tests with pseudo-random per-transaction memory latency (max 2, 3, 8, 16, 40) | all PASS | `results/phase2_latency_sweep.txt` |
| Randomized + vector regression vs independent Python model | 357 runs, 357 passed, 0 failed; 714666 transactions compared | `results/reference_model_results.txt` |
| Mutation check, 28 injected RTL bugs | Phase 2 directed bench detects 28/28; Phase 1 bench detects 22/28 | `results/phase2_mutation_results.txt` |
